onlyIntervention: deferral.applyWeights true versus false. Learning, proposed decision weights, reason questions/memory and sampler scope retained; off applies unit multipliers.
primary: raw model choice, sampler baseline after mandatory filters, actual selected action and executed result separately
proposed and applied weights; selection changes attributable to deferral rather than raw-choice/argmax disagreement
same-delivered-image route alternations with model-versus-policy origin; counts are descriptive not abnormality thresholds
retries of visible controls with intervening other-screen exploration and available outcomes/memory
case-level plausibility: distinguish observations, supported expectations, unsupported hypotheses and unknown human fidelity
secondary: objective success as context only, never rank naturalness
UI actions and gaze separate; API time not user thinking time
reviewRules: Goal failure or not pressing a correct control is not abnormal by itself.
Revisiting after other plausible places disappoint can be reasonable.
Identical pixels do not prove identical cognition or no new hypothesis.
Do not invent naturalness scores, revisit thresholds, human frequency or whole-trajectory counterfactuals.
Inspect both plausible unsuccessful exploration and repetition concerns, not only goal-achieving traces.
acceptance: on/off profiles differ only id and explicit flag
all history/reason/native information retained off; only multiplier application switches
computed proposal and applied distribution auditable and replayable
off does not bypass mandatory filters, normalize invalid probabilities or equate chosen label with probability argmax
comparison stops invalid model output/accounting/initial-pair mismatch; failure and missing retained
independent code and fresh actual-run review; fixes reverified
conditionalRepair: Fix demonstrated contract or execution bugs minimally. Keep the optimizer explicitly distinguishable from simulated-user action; do not tune routes or forbid revisits to maximize success. Human naturalness remains unvalidated without matched data.
